ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback. We are very sorry to hear your grill is not getting hot. We are here to help. 

If you are using your grill with the adapter hose to a larger 20 lb. refill/exchange LP tank, it sounds like your grill may be in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. Follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is also the way you would want to start your grill each and every time.
 
Open the lid
Make sure the control knob is in the off position
Turn your LP tank on all the way
Wait 60 seconds
Turn the burner to start/high (first position to the left)
Hit your igniter
Close the lid to preheat to 500-550°F
 
For troubleshooting purposes, I would suggest using your grill with a 14 or 16 oz. disposable LP cylinder as well. That will let you know right away if the issue is with the grill, or with the adapter hose/LP tank.

Our Care team will be reaching out to assist you further. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Cooks evenly no with no flare ups. Its well designed to circulate heat as fat drips down the grill grates channels the fat to avoid hitting the burners. Its a bit small so you can not do a whole lot but if your are cooking for a small crowd it is good. I love the consistent cooking results. Worth the expense. The one complaint I have is the plastic side trays that fold on top of the grill. They should be metal. They feel flimsy and I turned the grill on once without folding them out but fortunately i quickly remember and avoided melting them. I think that would be a reasonable upgrade.

Buuuuuuut, we can't take along our huge, heavy smoker when traveling so we had to find something that could satisfy the pro-griller guy while on the road. This is the second grill that we've purchased to take on the road in our truck camper, and we ABSOLUTELY LOVE IT! It's so easy to pack up, travel with, and use on the beach, at the campsite, and anywhere in between. Very realiable, easy to use and keeps even heat. Way better than the last grill we were gifted.
